basic_info.description: Jewel Box Victorian Duplex in the heart of The Excelsior. Built circa 1900, Charming duplex with loads of potential delivered vacant.  Ornate Victorian details abound, along with an enchanted garden beautifully landscaped complete with a koi pond and large (unwarranted)Greenhouse/art studio.  There are on-demand water heaters, a permitted new roof (2025) and permitted upgraded foundation (2005), one car garage.  Lower Flat: (310) 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, large eat in kitchen with high end range.  This unit has direct access to the garden and Art Studio. Wood floors, Victorian details, decorative fireplace and a formal living room, double paned windows, washer/dryer hook ups.  Upper Flat: (318)2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, great natural light, updated eat-in gas kitchen with new quartzite counter tops and new carpeting. Beautiful built-ins in living room, city views from living room.  Direct access from the kitchen to the back yard and washer dryer. There are stairs in the back of the unit with direct access to garden/yard.  Perfect for your 1031 Buyers or investors looking for rental property, or perhaps for 2 owner occupants to own as TICs!  Close to Mission St, and 101 freeway access.
